mentions.name: untamed.earth
mentions.description: This web app provides a map centered on the user that displays configurable points of interest nearby, aiming to list even obscure local features such as prehistoric burial mounds — like Atlas Obscura but much more local.
mentions.problem: Atlas Obscura doesn't list every local point of interest, such as prehistoric burial mounds, so the author wants a way to know where they all are.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Currently working on http://untamed.earth

Scratching an itch, the intention is that its a map, centered on the users that shows all (configurable) things of interest near by. Think of Atlas-Obscura but much more local - eg AO doesn't list every prehistoric burial mound on the planet, but I want to know where they are ;)
